card.name: Seems-good-but setup before a contrast
card.fires_on: Words in a clause that says something seems or appears true on the surface, just before a 'but' or 'however' that reverses it. It fires on the seeming word itself or on the words completing it, such as 'at first', 'on the surface' or 'to be positive'.

modes.label: Seems/appears verbs
modes.description: The verb 'seems', 'appears' or 'seemingly' that sets up an appearance later contradicted.

modes.label: End of the appearance phrase
modes.description: The last words of the appearance clause, such as 'at first', 'on the surface' or an adjective after 'seem to be'.

modes.description: The period closing a claim that is immediately qualified by a following 'But'.

card.writes: It promotes words like 'seemingly', 'looks like', and 'but actually', which prepare a contrast between appearance and reality.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text says how something looks at first, before a 'but' turns it around.
